TransUnion CIBIL — score range 300 to 900

What builds it

1 PAYMENT HISTORYevery EMI, on time
2 CREDIT UTILISATIONhow much of the limit you use
3 AGE OF CREDIThow old your accounts are
4 NEW ENQUIRIEShow often you apply

CIBIL names these factors — it publishes no percentage weights. Also counted: credit mix.

What destroys it

MONTH 1 OF 36

CIBIL — 36-month month-by-month payment history; it will always be a part of your credit history

ONE MISS = 36 MONTHS

The fix

AUTO-PAYevery due date

EVERY CARD
EVERY LOAN
AUTO-DEBIT or ALERT
REMEMBERING SHOULDN'T BE YOUR JOB

Use a SMALL share of the limit

PAY THE FULL BILL not the minimum
